description: The bar chart, titled “Mapping the Minds of LLMs: A Graph-Based Analysis of Reasoning LLM,” illustrates the token count for two distinct reasoning strategies—“Reasoning” (in brown) and “Demonstration” (in blue)—across five levels of “Number of Shots” (0 through 4) on the horizontal axis. The vertical axis, labeled “Token Count,” ranges from 0 to 7000 with major tick marks at intervals of 1000. At 0 shots, the “Reasoning” bar reaches 6393 tokens, while no “Demonstration” bar is present. For 1 shot, the “Reasoning” component is approximately 4441 tokens (6393 - 1952), with an additional “Demonstration” segment of 1952 tokens, summing to 6393. At 2 shots, “Reasoning” is around 4780 tokens (6393 - 1613), with “Demonstration” adding 1613 tokens. At 3 shots, “Reasoning” is about 5353 tokens (6393 - 1040), with “Demonstration” contributing 1040 tokens. At 4 shots, “Reasoning” is approximately 5014 tokens (6393 - 1379), with “Demonstration” adding 1379 tokens. Red downward arrows with negative values (-1952, -1613, -1040, -1379) indicate the token reduction in the “Reasoning” component relative to the 0-shot baseline, while the “Demonstration” portion is stacked on top to maintain a total token count close to 6393 across all shot levels. The chart visually suggests that as the number of shots increases, the token allocation shifts from pure “Reasoning” to a combination of “Reasoning” and “Demonstration,” with the total token budget remaining relatively constant.
